messages:
jess: quick question — I'm seeing weird values from /v1/usage when cached=true. response shows `prompt_tokens: 0` and only `completion_tokens`. is that the current contract? cc @sam @liam

sam: which endpoint exactly? and are you using include_cache param or a per-request flag? link to example would help.

jess: POST /v1/usage?include_cache=true using redwood-v1-small. example payload from the SDK below:
```json
{
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "cached": true,
  "prompt_tokens": 0,
  "completion_tokens": 120,
  "billable_units": 120
}
```

liam: that looks off. iirc the API preserved the original prompt token count for audit but charged only for the non-cached part. i.e. we should return original prompt length for recon. @accounting-bot any required field names from finance side?

accounting-bot: recommendation from billing: include explicit fields `prompt_tokens_recorded`, `completion_tokens_recorded`, and a top-level `chargeable_tokens`. this avoids ambiguity during recon. if we add `chargeable_tokens` we can compute totals reliably. :white_check_mark:

sam: minimal, backwards-compatible approach: keep `prompt_tokens` and `completion_tokens` as-is but add `cached_origin": "prefix_cache"` and `chargeable_tokens`. fallback rule: if `chargeable_tokens` missing, consumers fall back to `completion_tokens`. that keeps old clients working.

jess: good plan. can someone open a tiny API-change PR + migration note for the SDKs/docs? i need a snippet for the Node/Python SDKs.

liam: i'll open the PR. will add integration test asserting `chargeable_tokens` present when `cached` true and `cached_origin` set. will also update openapi.yml and add a short deprecation note for older behavior.

maria: i can QA in staging once the PR lands. i'll run the recon pipeline with accounting mocked to ensure we don't break invoices.

sam: also add a changelog entry (breaking? no, additive). bump the contract patch version. i'll review the PR once liam pushes.

jess: heads up for code reviewers — please call out fallback semantics clearly in PR description. :thumbsup:

(install-bot): deploy to staging queued — build 2026.3.1 in ~10m

maria: ran the tests locally, all green. filing a follow-up ticket for backfilling old events into `chargeable_tokens` when we flip the contract.

jess: thanks everyone. tracking issue INF-4523: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4523. i'll mark this resolved once PR merged and SDKs updated.
